description: I'm a 7th-semester student and work as an engineer by day. I built an ML project with cited, verifiable AI answers and now I'm applying that idea to farming. For Field Shift I'm building TEA: a tool that compares 3 crop rotations using NASA data (POWER, SMAP, GPM, NDVI), showing evidence, unknowns and risks for each. It supports farmers, never replaces them. Open to ideas, especially from agronomy or geospatial people.
